audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Deuteronomy / Devarim covenant blessing-and-curse discourse, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for covenant blessings, agricultural abundance, national elevation, escalating disease and ecological curses, defeat, sexual violence, family loss, siege cannibalism, mental anguish, exile, enslavement, and return-to-Egypt reversal. Maximum anti-trauma, anti-ableism, anti-antisemitism, anti-prosperity, and anti-victim-blaming safeguards required.

verses.restored: It shall be, if you diligently listen to voice of YHWH your Divine, keeping to do all his commands that I command you today, then YHWH your Divine will set you high above all nations of earth.

familiar.text: And it shall come to pass, if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe and to do all his commandments which I command thee this day, that the LORD thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth:

modern.text: “Now if you faithfully obey the voice of the LORD your God and are careful to follow all His commandments I am giving you today, the LORD your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth.

original.text: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם שָׁמ֤וֹעַ תִּשְׁמַע֙ בְּקוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֤ר לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת כָּל מִצְוֺתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּ֑וֹם וּנְתָ֨נְךָ֜ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ עֶלְי֔וֹן עַ֖ל כָּל גּוֹיֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: All these blessings shall come upon you and overtake you, because you listen to voice of YHWH your Divine.

familiar.text: And all these blessings shall come on thee, and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God.

modern.text: And all these blessings will come upon you and overtake you, if you will obey the voice of the LORD your God:

original.text: וּבָ֧אוּ עָלֶ֛יךָ כָּל הַבְּרָכ֥וֹת הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְהִשִּׂיגֻ֑ךָ כִּ֣י תִשְׁמַ֔ע בְּק֖וֹל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Blessed shall you be in city, and blessed shall you be in field.

familiar.text: Blessed shalt thou be in the city, and blessed shalt thou be in the field.

modern.text: You will be blessed in the city and blessed in the country.

original.text: בָּר֥וּךְ אַתָּ֖ה בָּעִ֑יר וּבָר֥וּךְ אַתָּ֖ה בַּשָּׂדֶֽה

verses.restored: Blessed shall be fruit of your womb, fruit of your ground, fruit of your livestock, offspring of your cattle, and increase of your flock.

familiar.text: Blessed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy ground, and the fruit of thy cattle, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.

modern.text: The fruit of your womb will be blessed, as well as the produce of your land and the offspring of your livestock— the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks.

original.text: בָּר֧וּךְ פְּרִֽי בִטְנְךָ֛ וּפְרִ֥י אַדְמָתְךָ֖ וּפְרִ֣י בְהֶמְתֶּ֑ךָ שְׁגַ֥ר אֲלָפֶ֖יךָ וְעַשְׁתְּר֥וֹת צֹאנֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Blessed shall be your basket and your kneading bowl.

familiar.text: Blessed shall be thy basket and thy store.

modern.text: Your basket and kneading bowl will be blessed.

original.text: בָּר֥וּךְ טַנְאֲךָ֖ וּמִשְׁאַרְתֶּֽךָ

verses.restored: Blessed shall you be when you come in, and blessed shall you be when you go out.

familiar.text: Blessed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and blessed shalt thou be when thou goest out.

modern.text: You will be blessed when you come in and blessed when you go out.

original.text: בָּר֥וּךְ אַתָּ֖ה בְּבֹאֶ֑ךָ וּבָר֥וּךְ אַתָּ֖ה בְּצֵאתֶֽךָ

verses.restored: YHWH will cause your enemies rising against you to be struck before you; by one way they shall come out to you, and by seven ways they shall flee before you.

familiar.text: The LORD shall cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thy face: they shall come out against thee one way, and flee before thee seven ways.

modern.text: The LORD will cause the enemies who rise up against you to be defeated before you. They will march out against you in one direction but flee from you in seven.

original.text: יִתֵּ֨ן יְהוָ֤ה אֶת אֹיְבֶ֨יךָ֙ הַקָּמִ֣ים עָלֶ֔יךָ נִגָּפִ֖ים לְפָנֶ֑יךָ בְּדֶ֤רֶךְ אֶחָד֙ יֵצְא֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וּבְשִׁבְעָ֥ה דְרָכִ֖ים יָנ֥וּסוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: YHWH will command blessing with you in your barns and in every undertaking of your hand, and he will bless you in land YHWH your Divine gives you.

familiar.text: The LORD shall command the blessing upon thee in thy storehouses, and in all that thou settest thine hand unto; and he shall bless thee in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

modern.text: The LORD will decree a blessing on your barns and on everything to which you put your hand; the LORD your God will bless you in the land He is giving you.

original.text: יְצַ֨ו יְהוָ֤ה אִתְּךָ֙ אֶת הַבְּרָכָ֔ה בַּאֲסָמֶ֕יךָ וּבְכֹ֖ל מִשְׁלַ֣ח יָדֶ֑ךָ וּבֵ֣רַכְךָ֔ בָּאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽךְ

verses.restored: YHWH will establish you for himself as holy people, as he swore to you, when you keep commands of YHWH your Divine and walk in his ways.

familiar.text: The LORD shall establish thee an holy people unto himself, as he hath sworn unto thee, if thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, and walk in his ways.

modern.text: The LORD will establish you as His holy people, just as He has sworn to you, if you keep the commandments of the LORD your God and walk in His ways.

original.text: יְקִֽימְךָ֨ יְהוָ֥ה לוֹ֙ לְעַ֣ם קָד֔וֹשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר נִֽשְׁבַּֽע לָ֑ךְ כִּ֣י תִשְׁמֹ֗ר אֶת מִצְוֺת֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ֖ בִּדְרָכָֽיו

verses.restored: All peoples of earth shall see that name of YHWH is called upon you, and they shall fear you.

familiar.text: And all people of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of the LORD; and they shall be afraid of thee.

modern.text: Then all the peoples of the earth will see that you are called by the name of the LORD, and they will stand in awe of you.

original.text: וְרָאוּ֙ כָּל עַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֛י שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה נִקְרָ֣א עָלֶ֑יךָ וְיָֽרְא֖וּ מִמֶּֽךָּ

verses.restored: YHWH will make you abound for good, in fruit of your womb, fruit of your livestock, and fruit of your ground, upon ground YHWH swore to your fathers to give you.

familiar.text: And the LORD shall make thee plenteous in goods, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy ground, in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers to give thee.

modern.text: The LORD will make you prosper abundantly—in the fruit of your womb, the offspring of your livestock, and the produce of your land—in the land that the LORD swore to your fathers to give you.

original.text: וְהוֹתִֽרְךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ לְטוֹבָ֔ה בִּפְרִ֧י בִטְנְךָ֛ וּבִפְרִ֥י בְהַמְתְּךָ֖ וּבִפְרִ֣י אַדְמָתֶ֑ךָ עַ֚ל הָאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע יְהוָ֛ה לַאֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ לָ֥תֶת לָֽךְ

verses.restored: YHWH will open for you his good treasury, heavens, to give rain of your land in its season and bless all work of your hand; you shall lend to many nations and shall not borrow.

familiar.text: The LORD shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow.

modern.text: The LORD will open the heavens, His abundant storehouse, to send rain on your land in season and to bless all the work of your hands. You will lend to many nations, but borrow from none.

original.text: יִפְתַּ֣ח יְהוָ֣ה לְ֠ךָ אֶת אוֹצָר֨וֹ הַטּ֜וֹב אֶת הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם לָתֵ֤ת מְטַֽר אַרְצְךָ֙ בְּעִתּ֔וֹ וּלְבָרֵ֕ךְ אֵ֖ת כָּל מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדֶ֑ךָ וְהִלְוִ֨יתָ֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים וְאַתָּ֖ה לֹ֥א תִלְוֶֽה

verses.restored: YHWH will make you head and not tail; you shall be only above and not beneath, when you listen to commands of YHWH your Divine that I command you today, to keep and do,

familiar.text: And the LORD shall make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the LORD thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do them:

modern.text: The LORD will make you the head and not the tail; you will only move upward and never downward, if you hear and carefully follow the commandments of the LORD your God, which I am giving you today.

original.text: וּנְתָֽנְךָ֨ יְהוָ֤ה לְרֹאשׁ֙ וְלֹ֣א לְזָנָ֔ב וְהָיִ֨יתָ֙ רַ֣ק לְמַ֔עְלָה וְלֹ֥א תִהְיֶ֖ה לְמָ֑טָּה כִּֽי תִשְׁמַ֞ע אֶל מִצְוֺ֣ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּךָ֛ הַיּ֖וֹם לִשְׁמֹ֥ר וְלַעֲשֽׂוֹת

verses.restored: and do not turn aside from any words I command you today, right or left, to go after other gods to serve them.

familiar.text: And thou shalt not go aside from any of the words which I command thee this day, to the right hand, or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.

modern.text: Do not turn aside to the right or to the left from any of the words I command you today, and do not go after other gods to serve them. The Curses of Disobedience (Leviticus 20:1–9; Leviticus 26:14–39)

original.text: וְלֹ֣א תָס֗וּר מִכָּל הַדְּבָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֜י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֛ם הַיּ֖וֹם יָמִ֣ין וּשְׂמֹ֑אול לָלֶ֗כֶת אַחֲרֵ֛י אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים לְעָבְדָֽם

verses.restored: But it shall be, if you do not listen to voice of YHWH your Divine, to keep to do all his commands and statutes that I command you today, then all these curses shall come upon you and overtake you.

familiar.text: But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee:

modern.text: If, however, you do not obey the LORD your God by carefully following all His commandments and statutes I am giving you today, all these curses will come upon you and overtake you:

original.text: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם לֹ֤א תִשְׁמַע֙ בְּקוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֤ר לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת כָּל מִצְוֺתָ֣יו וְחֻקֹּתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּ֑וֹם וּבָ֧אוּ עָלֶ֛יךָ כָּל הַקְּלָל֥וֹת הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְהִשִּׂיגֽוּךָ

verses.restored: Cursed shall you be in city, and cursed shall you be in field.

familiar.text: Cursed shalt thou be in the city, and cursed shalt thou be in the field.

modern.text: You will be cursed in the city and cursed in the country.

original.text: אָר֥וּר אַתָּ֖ה בָּעִ֑יר וְאָר֥וּר אַתָּ֖ה בַּשָּׂדֶֽה

verses.restored: Cursed shall be your basket and your kneading bowl.

familiar.text: Cursed shall be thy basket and thy store.

modern.text: Your basket and kneading bowl will be cursed.

original.text: אָר֥וּר טַנְאֲךָ֖ וּמִשְׁאַרְתֶּֽךָ

verses.restored: Cursed shall be fruit of your womb, fruit of your ground, offspring of your cattle, and increase of your flock.

familiar.text: Cursed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy land, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.

modern.text: The fruit of your womb will be cursed, as well as the produce of your land, the calves of your herds, and the lambs of your flocks.

original.text: אָר֥וּר פְּרִֽי בִטְנְךָ֖ וּפְרִ֣י אַדְמָתֶ֑ךָ שְׁגַ֥ר אֲלָפֶ֖יךָ וְעַשְׁתְּר֥וֹת צֹאנֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Cursed shall you be when you come in, and cursed shall you be when you go out.

familiar.text: Cursed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and cursed shalt thou be when thou goest out.

modern.text: You will be cursed when you come in and cursed when you go out.

original.text: אָר֥וּר אַתָּ֖ה בְּבֹאֶ֑ךָ וְאָר֥וּר אַתָּ֖ה בְּצֵאתֶֽךָ

verses.restored: YHWH will send against you curse, confusion, and rebuke in every undertaking of your hand that you do, until you are destroyed and perish quickly because of evil of your deeds by which you forsook me.

familiar.text: The LORD shall send upon thee cursing, vexation, and rebuke, in all that thou settest thine hand unto for to do, until thou be destroyed, and until thou perish quickly; because of the wickedness of thy doings, whereby thou hast forsaken me.

modern.text: The LORD will send curses upon you, confusion and reproof in all to which you put your hand, until you are destroyed and quickly perish because of the wickedness you have committed in forsaking Him.

original.text: יְשַׁלַּ֣ח יְהוָ֣ה בְּ֠ךָ אֶת הַמְּאֵרָ֤ה אֶת הַמְּהוּמָה֙ וְאֶת הַמִּגְעֶ֔רֶת בְּכָל מִשְׁלַ֥ח יָדְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲשֶׂ֑ה עַ֣ד הִשָּֽׁמֶדְךָ֤ וְעַד אֲבָדְךָ֙ מַהֵ֔ר מִפְּנֵ֛י רֹ֥עַ מַֽעֲלָלֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲזַבְתָּֽנִי

verses.restored: YHWH will make pestilence cling to you until it consumes you from ground where you are entering to possess it.

familiar.text: The LORD shall make the pestilence cleave unto thee, until he have consumed thee from off the land, whither thou goest to possess it.

modern.text: The LORD will make the plague cling to you until He has exterminated you from the land that you are entering to possess.

original.text: יַדְבֵּ֧ק יְהוָ֛ה בְּךָ֖ אֶת הַדָּ֑בֶר עַ֚ד כַּלֹּת֣וֹ אֹֽתְךָ֔ מֵעַל֙ הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר אַתָּ֥ה בָא שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ

verses.restored: YHWH will strike you with wasting disease, fever, inflammation, burning heat, drought/sword, blight, and mildew; they shall pursue you until you perish.

familiar.text: The LORD shall smite thee with a consumption, and with a fever, and with an inflammation, and with an extreme burning, and with the sword, and with blasting, and with mildew; and they shall pursue thee until thou perish.

modern.text: The LORD will strike you with wasting disease, with fever and inflammation, with scorching heat and drought, and with blight and mildew; these will pursue you until you perish.

original.text: יַכְּכָ֣ה יְ֠הוָה בַּשַּׁחֶ֨פֶת וּבַקַּדַּ֜חַת וּבַדַּלֶּ֗קֶת וּבַֽחַרְחֻר֙ וּבַחֶ֔רֶב וּבַשִּׁדָּפ֖וֹן וּבַיֵּרָק֑וֹן וּרְדָפ֖וּךָ עַ֥ד אָבְדֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Your heavens that are over your head shall be bronze, and earth beneath you iron.

familiar.text: And thy heaven that is over thy head shall be brass, and the earth that is under thee shall be iron.

modern.text: The sky over your head will be bronze, and the earth beneath you iron.

original.text: וְהָי֥וּ שָׁמֶ֛יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל רֹאשְׁךָ֖ נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וְהָאָ֥רֶץ אֲשֶׁר תַּחְתֶּ֖יךָ בַּרְזֶֽל

verses.restored: YHWH will make rain of your land dust and powder; from heavens it shall come down upon you until you are destroyed.

familiar.text: The LORD shall make the rain of thy land powder and dust: from heaven shall it come down upon thee, until thou be destroyed.

modern.text: The LORD will turn the rain of your land into dust and powder; it will descend on you from the sky until you are destroyed.

original.text: יִתֵּ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה אֶת מְטַ֥ר אַרְצְךָ֖ אָבָ֣ק וְעָפָ֑ר מִן הַשָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ יֵרֵ֣ד עָלֶ֔יךָ עַ֖ד הִשָּׁמְדָֽךְ

verses.restored: YHWH will cause you to be struck before your enemies; by one way you shall go out to them, and by seven ways you shall flee before them, and you shall become a horror to all kingdoms of earth.

familiar.text: The LORD shall cause thee to be smitten before thine enemies: thou shalt go out one way against them, and flee seven ways before them: and shalt be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.

modern.text: The LORD will cause you to be defeated before your enemies. You will march out against them in one direction but flee from them in seven. You will be an object of horror to all the kingdoms of the earth.

original.text: יִתֶּנְךָ֨ יְהוָ֥ה נִגָּף֮ לִפְנֵ֣י אֹיְבֶיךָ֒ בְּדֶ֤רֶךְ אֶחָד֙ תֵּצֵ֣א אֵלָ֔יו וּבְשִׁבְעָ֥ה דְרָכִ֖ים תָּנ֣וּס לְפָנָ֑יו וְהָיִ֣יתָ לְזַעֲוָ֔ה לְכֹ֖ל מַמְלְכ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: Your corpse shall become food for every bird of heavens and beast of earth, with none frightening them away.

familiar.text: And thy carcase shall be meat unto all fowls of the air, and unto the beasts of the earth, and no man shall fray them away.

modern.text: Your corpses will be food for all the birds of the air and beasts of the earth, with no one to scare them away.

original.text: וְהָיְתָ֤ה נִבְלָֽתְךָ֙ לְמַאֲכָ֔ל לְכָל ע֥וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וּלְבֶהֱמַ֣ת הָאָ֑רֶץ וְאֵ֖ין מַחֲרִֽיד

verses.restored: YHWH will strike you with boil of Egypt, tumors, scurvy, and itch from which you cannot be healed.

familiar.text: The LORD will smite thee with the botch of Egypt, and with the emerods, and with the scab, and with the itch, whereof thou canst not be healed.

modern.text: The LORD will afflict you with the boils of Egypt, with tumors and scabs and itch from which you cannot be cured.

original.text: יַכְּכָ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה בִּשְׁחִ֤ין מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ ובעפלים וּבַגָּרָ֖ב וּבֶחָ֑רֶס אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא תוּכַ֖ל לְהֵרָפֵֽא

verses.restored: YHWH will strike you with madness, blindness, and bewilderment of heart.

familiar.text: The LORD shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart:

modern.text: The LORD will afflict you with madness, blindness, and confusion of mind,

original.text: יַכְּכָ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה בְּשִׁגָּע֖וֹן וּבְעִוָּר֑וֹן וּבְתִמְה֖וֹן לֵבָֽב

verses.restored: You shall grope at noon as blind person gropes in darkness, and you shall not make your ways prosper; you shall be only oppressed and robbed all days, with none saving.

familiar.text: And thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways: and thou shalt be only oppressed and spoiled evermore, and no man shall save thee.

modern.text: and at noon you will grope about like a blind man in the darkness. You will not prosper in your ways. Day after day you will be oppressed and plundered, with no one to save you.

original.text: וְהָיִ֜יתָ מְמַשֵּׁ֣שׁ בַּֽצָּהֳרַ֗יִם כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יְמַשֵּׁ֤שׁ הָעִוֵּר֙ בָּאֲפֵלָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א תַצְלִ֖יחַ אֶת דְּרָכֶ֑יךָ וְהָיִ֜יתָ אַ֣ךְ עָשׁ֧וּק וְגָז֛וּל כָּל הַיָּמִ֖ים וְאֵ֥ין מוֹשִֽׁיעַ

verses.restored: A woman you shall betroth, and another man shall violate her; a house you shall build and not dwell in it; a vineyard you shall plant and not begin to enjoy it.

familiar.text: Thou shalt betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her: thou shalt build an house, and thou shalt not dwell therein: thou shalt plant a vineyard, and shalt not gather the grapes thereof.

modern.text: You will be pledged in marriage to a woman, but another man will violate her. You will build a house but will not live in it. You will plant a vineyard but will not enjoy its fruit.

original.text: אִשָּׁ֣ה תְאָרֵ֗שׂ וְאִ֤ישׁ אַחֵר֙ ישגלנה בַּ֥יִת תִּבְנֶ֖ה וְלֹא תֵשֵׁ֣ב בּ֑וֹ כֶּ֥רֶם תִּטַּ֖ע וְלֹ֥א תְחַלְּלֶּֽנּוּ

verses.restored: Your ox shall be slaughtered before your eyes and you shall not eat from it; your donkey shall be robbed from before your face and not return to you; your flock shall be given to your enemies, with none saving for you.

familiar.text: Thine ox shall be slain before thine eyes, and thou shalt not eat thereof: thine ass shall be violently taken away from before thy face, and shall not be restored to thee: thy sheep shall be given unto thine enemies, and thou shalt have none to rescue them.

modern.text: Your ox will be slaughtered before your eyes, but you will not eat any of it. Your donkey will be taken away and not returned to you. Your flock will be given to your enemies, and no one will save you.

original.text: שׁוֹרְךָ֞ טָב֣וּחַ לְעֵינֶ֗יךָ וְלֹ֣א תֹאכַל֮ מִמֶּנּוּ֒ חֲמֹֽרְךָ֙ גָּז֣וּל מִלְּפָנֶ֔יךָ וְלֹ֥א יָשׁ֖וּב לָ֑ךְ צֹֽאנְךָ֙ נְתֻנ֣וֹת לְאֹיְבֶ֔יךָ וְאֵ֥ין לְךָ֖ מוֹשִֽׁיעַ

verses.restored: Your sons and daughters shall be given to another people, and your eyes shall see and fail with longing for them all day, but there shall be no power in your hand.

familiar.text: Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people, and thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long: and there shall be no might in thine hand:

modern.text: Your sons and daughters will be given to another nation, while your eyes grow weary looking for them day after day, with no power in your hand.

original.text: בָּנֶ֨יךָ וּבְנֹתֶ֜יךָ נְתֻנִ֨ים לְעַ֤ם אַחֵר֙ וְעֵינֶ֣יךָ רֹא֔וֹת וְכָל֥וֹת אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם כָּל הַיּ֑וֹם וְאֵ֥ין לְאֵ֖ל יָדֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Fruit of your ground and all your labor a people you do not know shall eat, and you shall be only oppressed and crushed all days.

familiar.text: The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway:

modern.text: A people you do not know will eat the produce of your land and of all your toil. All your days you will be oppressed and crushed.

original.text: פְּרִ֤י אַדְמָֽתְךָ֙ וְכָל יְגִ֣יעֲךָ֔ יֹאכַ֥ל עַ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא יָדָ֑עְתָּ וְהָיִ֗יתָ רַ֛ק עָשׁ֥וּק וְרָצ֖וּץ כָּל הַיָּמִֽים

verses.restored: You shall become mad from sight of your eyes that you see.

familiar.text: So that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.

modern.text: You will be driven mad by the sights you see.

original.text: וְהָיִ֖יתָ מְשֻׁגָּ֑ע מִמַּרְאֵ֥ה עֵינֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְאֶֽה

verses.restored: YHWH will strike you on knees and legs with evil boils from which you cannot be healed, from sole of your foot even to crown of your head.

familiar.text: The LORD shall smite thee in the knees, and in the legs, with a sore botch that cannot be healed, from the sole of thy foot unto the top of thy head.

modern.text: The LORD will afflict you with painful, incurable boils on your knees and thighs, from the soles of your feet to the top of your head.

original.text: יַכְּכָ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה בִּשְׁחִ֣ין רָ֗ע עַל הַבִּרְכַּ֨יִם֙ וְעַל הַשֹּׁקַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא תוּכַ֖ל לְהֵרָפֵ֑א מִכַּ֥ף רַגְלְךָ֖ וְעַ֥ד קָדְקֳדֶֽךָ

verses.restored: YHWH will lead you and your king whom you set over you to a nation you and your fathers did not know, and there you shall serve other gods, wood and stone.

familiar.text: The LORD shall bring thee, and thy king which thou shalt set over thee, unto a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers have known; and there shalt thou serve other gods, wood and stone.

modern.text: The LORD will bring you and the king you appoint to a nation neither you nor your fathers have known, and there you will worship other gods—gods of wood and stone.

original.text: יוֹלֵ֨ךְ יְהוָ֜ה אֹֽתְךָ֗ וְאֶֽת מַלְכְּךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תָּקִ֣ים עָלֶ֔יךָ אֶל גּ֕וֹי אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא יָדַ֖עְתָּ אַתָּ֣ה וַאֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ וְעָבַ֥דְתָּ שָּׁ֛ם אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים עֵ֥ץ וָאָֽבֶן

verses.restored: You shall become astonishment, proverb, and byword among all peoples where YHWH leads you.

familiar.text: And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations whither the LORD shall lead thee.

modern.text: You will become an object of horror, scorn, and ridicule among all the nations to which the LORD will drive you.

original.text: וְהָיִ֣יתָ לְשַׁמָּ֔ה לְמָשָׁ֖ל וְלִשְׁנִינָ֑ה בְּכֹל֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁר יְנַהֶגְךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה שָֽׁמָּה

verses.restored: Much seed you shall bring out to field, but little you shall gather, for locust shall consume it.

familiar.text: Thou shalt carry much seed out into the field, and shalt gather but little in; for the locust shall consume it.

modern.text: You will sow much seed in the field but harvest little, because the locusts will consume it.

original.text: זֶ֥רַע רַ֖ב תּוֹצִ֣יא הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה וּמְעַ֣ט תֶּאֱסֹ֔ף כִּ֥י יַחְסְלֶ֖נּוּ הָאַרְבֶּֽה

verses.restored: Vineyards you shall plant and cultivate, but wine you shall not drink or gather, for worm shall eat them.

familiar.text: Thou shalt plant vineyards, and dress them, but shalt neither drink of the wine, nor gather the grapes; for the worms shall eat them.

modern.text: You will plant and cultivate vineyards, but will neither drink the wine nor gather the grapes, because worms will eat them.

original.text: כְּרָמִ֥ים תִּטַּ֖ע וְעָבָ֑דְתָּ וְיַ֤יִן לֹֽא תִשְׁתֶּה֙ וְלֹ֣א תֶאֱגֹ֔ר כִּ֥י תֹאכְלֶ֖נּוּ הַתֹּלָֽעַת

verses.restored: Olive trees shall be yours in all your territory, but oil you shall not anoint yourself with, for your olives shall drop off.

familiar.text: Thou shalt have olive trees throughout all thy coasts, but thou shalt not anoint thyself with the oil; for thine olive shall cast his fruit.

modern.text: You will have olive trees throughout your territory but will never anoint yourself with oil, because the olives will drop off.

original.text: זֵיתִ֛ים יִהְי֥וּ לְךָ֖ בְּכָל גְּבוּלֶ֑ךָ וְשֶׁ֨מֶן֙ לֹ֣א תָס֔וּךְ כִּ֥י יִשַּׁ֖ל זֵיתֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Sons and daughters you shall father, but they shall not be yours, for they shall go into captivity.

familiar.text: Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but thou shalt not enjoy them; for they shall go into captivity.

modern.text: You will father sons and daughters, but they will not remain yours, because they will go into captivity.

original.text: בָּנִ֥ים וּבָנ֖וֹת תּוֹלִ֑יד וְלֹא יִהְי֣וּ לָ֔ךְ כִּ֥י יֵלְכ֖וּ בַּשֶּֽׁבִי

verses.restored: All your trees and fruit of your ground whirring locust shall possess.

familiar.text: All thy trees and fruit of thy land shall the locust consume.

modern.text: Swarms of locusts will consume all your trees and the produce of your land.

original.text: כָּל עֵצְךָ֖ וּפְרִ֣י אַדְמָתֶ֑ךָ יְיָרֵ֖שׁ הַצְּלָצַֽל

verses.restored: Sojourner who is in your midst shall rise over you higher and higher, and you shall descend lower and lower.

familiar.text: The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high; and thou shalt come down very low.

modern.text: The foreigner living among you will rise higher and higher above you, while you sink down lower and lower.

original.text: הַגֵּר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּקִרְבְּךָ֔ יַעֲלֶ֥ה עָלֶ֖יךָ מַ֣עְלָה מָּ֑עְלָה וְאַתָּ֥ה תֵרֵ֖ד מַ֥טָּה מָּֽטָּה

verses.restored: He shall lend to you and you shall not lend to him; he shall be head and you shall be tail.

familiar.text: He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.

modern.text: He will lend to you, but you will not lend to him. He will be the head, and you will be the tail.

original.text: ה֣וּא יַלְוְךָ֔ וְאַתָּ֖ה לֹ֣א תַלְוֶ֑נּוּ ה֚וּא יִהְיֶ֣ה לְרֹ֔אשׁ וְאַתָּ֖ה תִּֽהְיֶ֥ה לְזָנָֽב

verses.restored: All these curses shall come upon you and pursue you and overtake you until you are destroyed, because you did not listen to voice of YHWH your Divine, to keep his commands and statutes that he commanded you.

familiar.text: Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded thee:

modern.text: All these curses will come upon you. They will pursue you and overtake you until you are destroyed, since you did not obey the LORD your God and keep the commandments and statutes He gave you.

original.text: וּבָ֨אוּ עָלֶ֜יךָ כָּל הַקְּלָל֣וֹת הָאֵ֗לֶּה וּרְדָפ֨וּךָ֙ וְהִשִּׂיג֔וּךָ עַ֖ד הִשָּֽׁמְדָ֑ךְ כִּי לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֗עְתָּ בְּקוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֛ר מִצְוֺתָ֥יו וְחֻקֹּתָ֖יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּֽךְ

verses.restored: They shall be upon you as sign and wonder, and upon your seed forever.

familiar.text: And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.

modern.text: These curses will be a sign and a wonder upon you and your descendants forever.

original.text: וְהָי֣וּ בְךָ֔ לְא֖וֹת וּלְמוֹפֵ֑ת וּֽבְזַרְעֲךָ֖ עַד עוֹלָֽם

verses.restored: Because you did not serve YHWH your Divine with joy and goodness of heart from abundance of all things,

familiar.text: Because thou servedst not the LORD thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all things;

modern.text: Because you did not serve the LORD your God with joy and gladness of heart in all your abundance,

original.text: תַּ֗חַת אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹא עָבַ֨דְתָּ֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בְּשִׂמְחָ֖ה וּבְט֣וּב לֵבָ֑ב מֵרֹ֖ב כֹּֽל

verses.restored: you shall serve your enemies whom YHWH sends against you, in hunger, thirst, nakedness, and lack of all things; he shall put iron yoke upon your neck until he destroys you.

familiar.text: Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the LORD shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.

modern.text: you will serve your enemies the LORD will send against you in famine, thirst, nakedness, and destitution. He will place an iron yoke on your neck until He has destroyed you.

original.text: וְעָבַדְתָּ֣ אֶת אֹיְבֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְשַׁלְּחֶ֤נּוּ יְהוָה֙ בָּ֔ךְ בְּרָעָ֧ב וּבְצָמָ֛א וּבְעֵירֹ֖ם וּבְחֹ֣סֶר כֹּ֑ל וְנָתַ֞ן עֹ֤ל בַּרְזֶל֙ עַל צַוָּארֶ֔ךָ עַ֥ד הִשְׁמִיד֖וֹ אֹתָֽךְ

verses.restored: YHWH will raise against you a nation from far, from end of earth, as eagle swoops, a nation whose language you do not understand,

familiar.text: The LORD shall bring a nation against thee from far, from the end of the earth, as swift as the eagle flieth; a nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand;

modern.text: The LORD will bring a nation from afar, from the ends of the earth, to swoop down upon you like an eagle—a nation whose language you will not understand,

original.text: יִשָּׂ֣א יְהוָה֩ עָלֶ֨יךָ גּ֤וֹי מֵרָחוֹק֙ מִקְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יִדְאֶ֖ה הַנָּ֑שֶׁר גּ֕וֹי אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא תִשְׁמַ֖ע לְשֹׁנֽוֹ

verses.restored: a nation fierce of face, which does not lift face/show regard to old and does not show favor to young.

familiar.text: A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old, nor shew favour to the young:

modern.text: a ruthless nation with no respect for the old and no pity for the young.

original.text: גּ֖וֹי עַ֣ז פָּנִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא יִשָּׂ֤א פָנִים֙ לְזָקֵ֔ן וְנַ֖עַר לֹ֥א יָחֹֽן

verses.restored: It shall eat fruit of your livestock and fruit of your ground until you are destroyed; it shall leave you no grain, new wine, oil, offspring of cattle, or increase of flock, until it causes you to perish.

familiar.text: And he shall eat the fruit of thy cattle, and the fruit of thy land, until thou be destroyed: which also shall not leave thee either corn, wine, or oil, or the increase of thy kine, or flocks of thy sheep, until he have destroyed thee.

modern.text: They will eat the offspring of your livestock and the produce of your land until you are destroyed. They will leave you no grain or new wine or oil, no calves of your herds or lambs of your flocks, until they have caused you to perish.

original.text: וְ֠אָכַל פְּרִ֨י בְהֶמְתְּךָ֥ וּפְרִֽי אַדְמָתְךָ֮ עַ֣ד הִשָּֽׁמְדָךְ֒ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא יַשְׁאִ֜יר לְךָ֗ דָּגָן֙ תִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְיִצְהָ֔ר שְׁגַ֥ר אֲלָפֶ֖יךָ וְעַשְׁתְּרֹ֣ת צֹאנֶ֑ךָ עַ֥ד הַאֲבִיד֖וֹ אֹתָֽךְ

verses.restored: It shall besiege you in all your gates until your high and fortified walls in which you trust fall throughout your land; it shall besiege you in all your gates throughout land YHWH your Divine gave you.

familiar.text: And he shall besiege thee in all thy gates, until thy high and fenced walls come down, wherein thou trustedst, throughout all thy land: and he shall besiege thee in all thy gates throughout all thy land, which the LORD thy God hath given thee.

modern.text: They will besiege all the cities throughout your land, until the high and fortified walls in which you trust have fallen. They will besiege all your cities throughout the land that the LORD your God has given you.

original.text: וְהֵצַ֨ר לְךָ֜ בְּכָל שְׁעָרֶ֗יךָ עַ֣ד רֶ֤דֶת חֹמֹתֶ֨יךָ֙ הַגְּבֹה֣וֹת וְהַבְּצֻר֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֛ה בֹּטֵ֥חַ בָּהֵ֖ן בְּכָל אַרְצֶ֑ךָ וְהֵצַ֤ר לְךָ֙ בְּכָל שְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ בְּכָ֨ל אַרְצְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֛ן יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לָֽךְ

verses.restored: You shall eat fruit of your womb, flesh of your sons and daughters whom YHWH your Divine gave you, in siege and distress with which your enemy distresses you.

familiar.text: And thou shalt eat the fruit of thine own body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters, which the LORD thy God hath given thee, in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee:

modern.text: Then you will eat the fruit of your womb, the flesh of the sons and daughters whom the LORD your God has given you, in the siege and distress that your enemy will inflict on you.

original.text: וְאָכַלְתָּ֣ פְרִֽי בִטְנְךָ֗ בְּשַׂ֤ר בָּנֶ֨יךָ֙ וּבְנֹתֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתַן לְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ בְּמָצוֹר֙ וּבְמָצ֔וֹק אֲשֶׁר יָצִ֥יק לְךָ֖ אֹיְבֶֽךָ

verses.restored: The man among you tender and very delicate, his eye shall be evil toward his brother, wife of his embrace, and remainder of children he leaves,

familiar.text: So that the man that is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye shall be evil toward his brother, and toward the wife of his bosom, and toward the remnant of his children which he shall leave:

modern.text: The most gentle and refined man among you will begrudge his brother, the wife he embraces, and the rest of his children who have survived,

translation_notes: The blessing section is covenant rhetoric about communal flourishing, not a prosperity guarantee that righteous individuals will always be wealthy, fertile, healthy, victorious, or safe.

The curse section is an escalating ancient treaty-warning and trauma catalogue involving ecological collapse, epidemic, disability imagery, robbery, sexual violence, child loss, siege starvation, cannibalism, captivity, psychological terror, exile, and enslavement.
No illness, disability, infertility, poverty, assault, war loss, displacement, or mental-health crisis should ever be treated as evidence that a sufferer disobeyed Divine command.

Blindness, madness, boils, and disease are used rhetorically as horrors in the ancient text; modern reception must reject ableism and stigma toward blind, disabled, neurodivergent, mentally ill, or chronically ill people.
Verse 30 includes sexual violation as a weapon of defeat. Survivors are never responsible for violence done to them.
Verses 53-57 preserve siege cannibalism as an atrocity of starvation and social collapse, not a Divine ideal or a basis for shaming parents trapped in famine.

The chapter has been weaponized in antisemitic and supersessionist traditions to portray Jewish suffering and exile as proof of Divine rejection. That use is categorically false to Jewish covenant continuity and must be rejected.
Serving with joy in verse 47 cannot be used to demand emotional performance from traumatized, depressed, grieving, disabled, or coerced people.
The return to Egypt reverses Exodus and depicts total loss of freedom; it does not legitimate slavery.
The chapter requires comparison with Deuteronomy 30, where return, compassion, restoration, and renewed life remain possible.
safety_note: Never use Deuteronomy 28 to tell sick, disabled, infertile, poor, assaulted, grieving, displaced, enslaved, traumatized, or war-affected people that they deserved their suffering. Never use it for antisemitism, supersessionism, prosperity preaching, disaster blame, coercive religion, sexual shaming, ableism, or justification of siege and collective punishment. Read the curses as ancient covenant catastrophe rhetoric whose human horrors must be prevented, relieved, and never reenacted.
